summary: This clinical study tests the drug enlicitide along with rosuvastatin in adults with high levels of fats in the blood, known as hyperlipidemia. Researchers want to compare the effects of these study drugs against an inactive substance called a placebo. The study includes 996 participants to see how the treatments affect cholesterol levels. Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC is the sponsor for this Phase 3 trial, which is currently Active, not recruiting.
